title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 1.33 (quiet) at 02:00 UTC on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日 02:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 1.33（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest hour-start estimated Kp = 1.33 (label 1P). Last-180 maximum 1.33 first at 23:58 UTC on 20 September (label 1P; last-180 window from 23:09 UTC). Published-window maximum 1.33. Window start 20:11 UTC (358 samples). 01:00 hour is now complete (60 samples); 01:00 hour-start revised to 1.33/1P. 02:00 UTC follows 01:59 1.33/1P and is a real hour-start, not a trailing placeholder. 02:00 hour is still incomplete (9 samples to 02:08 UTC) so the card uses the hour-start minute. estimated_kp remains below 5.0.
summary.zh: 最新整點估計 Kp = 1.33（標籤 1P）。近 180 筆最大 1.33（最先見於 2026-09-20 23:58 UTC；標籤 1P；近 180 筆窗自 23:09 UTC 起）；公開窗最大 1.33。窗起點 20:11 UTC（358 筆）。01:00 時段已收滿 60 筆，01:00 整點修正為 1.33／1P。02:00 UTC 接在 01:59 的 1.33／1P 之後，視為真實整點值而非尾端占位。02:00 時段尚未收滿（至 02:08 UTC 共 9 筆），主卡片採用整點分鐘。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute that is not a trailing 0.00/0Z placeholder (02:00 UTC). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off.

title.en: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake occurred 35 km NNE of Ruteng, Indonesia on 21 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 21 日，印尼 Ruteng 北北東約 35 公里發生規模 5.5 地震。

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 5.5, depth about 10 km. Newly listed this hour. Current day-feed maximum is mww 6.4 (us7000tiqc, Papua New Guinea).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 5.5，深度約 10 公里。本輪新上架。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 6.4（us7000tiqc，巴布亞紐幾內亞）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
